ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut. Gate spot-checked: internal/proc/driver.go:74-77 — Child carries no record/store/reaper field, with the comment stating settlement's only executor is the driver goroutine Spawn started; drive()'s tail (driver.go:199-208) publishes Exit{Reap, RecordFate} and closes c.settled exactly once, RecordAbandoned the additive default fate. The old proc/worker/wire packages are deleted (top-level worker/ and daemon/ absent); the ownership-driver invariant is now structural, not conventional.
